Synthetic 240x240 textured-pan fixture generated by the repository's
scripts/benchmark-image-codecs.sh --fixtures /tmp/moss-codec-fixtures
and MossEncodeJPEG240 at quality 0.50. It contains procedural shapes/noise,
not a screenshot or personal data. Source RGB pixels are quantized to RGB565.
APP1..APP15/COM metadata were stripped by the production encoder.

Baseline 4:2:0 JPEG, 6636 bytes. Pinned JPEGDEC RGB565 little-endian output
FNV-1a (bytes low then high per pixel): 02aa0842.
